research_rationale:
EO 9294 (January 4, 1943, Franklin D. Roosevelt), read in full in the held Federal Register text, further defines the functions and duties of the Office of Defense Transportation. Its lead defines terms and powers; numbered paragraphs 1 to 5 define "local passenger transportation equipment" (1), add functions beyond those in EO 8989 (2), bar contractors and agencies from certain uses (3), preserve the authority of the Chairman of the War Manpower Commission (4) and exempt military and naval movements (5); a second group of two items, printed after the Federal Register contents column and read by the machine inventory as rows "1-dup2" and "2-dup2", extends the Office's authority to domestic transportation in territories and possessions and designates the Director as the agency head for requisitioning under EO 8942. The order has no stated term. EO 9625 (September 21, 1945), held only as an American Presidency Project transcription, revokes it by number. That is the first end.
